import Mathlib

inductive BinarySearchTree : Type
| Empty : BinarySearchTree
| Node : Int → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree

def view (t : BinarySearchTree) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => ∅
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_bst (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => True
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def insert_precond (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_bst t
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def bstInsertRaw (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int) : BinarySearchTree :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty =>
      BinarySearchTree.Node v
        BinarySearchTree.Empty BinarySearchTree.Empty
  | BinarySearchTree.Node x l r =>
      if v < x then
        BinarySearchTree.Node x (bstInsertRaw l v) r
      else if x < v then
        BinarySearchTree.Node x l (bstInsertRaw r v)
      else
        BinarySearchTree.Node x l r
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def insert (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : insert_precond t v) : BinarySearchTree :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  bstInsertRaw t v
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def insert_postcond (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int) (result : BinarySearchTree)
    (_ : insert_precond t v) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_bst result ∧
  view result = view t ∪ {v}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem bstInsertRaw_spec :
    ∀ (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int), is_bst t →
      is_bst (bstInsertRaw t v) ∧
      view (bstInsertRaw t v) = view t ∪ {v} := by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | Empty =>
      intro v _
      simp [bstInsertRaw, is_bst, view]
  | Node x l r ihl ihr =>
      intro v hbst
      change
        (∀ z ∈ view l, z < x) ∧
        is_bst l ∧
        (∀ z ∈ view r, z > x) ∧
        is_bst r at hbst
      rcases hbst with ⟨hlBound, hlBst, hrBound, hrBst⟩

      by_cases hvx : v < x
      · have il := ihl v hlBst
        have hins :
            bstInsertRaw (BinarySearchTree.Node x l r) v =
              BinarySearchTree.Node x (bstInsertRaw l v) r := by
          simp [bstInsertRaw, hvx]
        rw [hins]
        constructor
        · change
            (∀ z ∈ view (bstInsertRaw l v), z < x) ∧
            is_bst (bstInsertRaw l v) ∧
            (∀ z ∈ view r, z > x) ∧
            is_bst r
          refine ⟨?_, il.1, hrBound, hrBst⟩
          intro z hz
          rw [il.2] at hz
          rcases hz with hz | hz
          · exact hlBound z hz
          · have hzEq : z = v := by
              simpa using hz
            subst z
            exact hvx
        · change
            view (bstInsertRaw l v) ∪ view r ∪ {x} =
              (view l ∪ view r ∪ {x}) ∪ {v}
          rw [il.2]
          ext z
          simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
          tauto

      · by_cases hxv : x < v
        · have ir := ihr v hrBst
          have hins :
              bstInsertRaw (BinarySearchTree.Node x l r) v =
                BinarySearchTree.Node x l (bstInsertRaw r v) := by
            simp [bstInsertRaw, hvx, hxv]
          rw [hins]
          constructor
          · change
              (∀ z ∈ view l, z < x) ∧
              is_bst l ∧
              (∀ z ∈ view (bstInsertRaw r v), z > x) ∧
              is_bst (bstInsertRaw r v)
            refine ⟨hlBound, hlBst, ?_, ir.1⟩
            intro z hz
            rw [ir.2] at hz
            rcases hz with hz | hz
            · exact hrBound z hz
            · have hzEq : z = v := by
                simpa using hz
              subst z
              exact hxv
          · change
              view l ∪ view (bstInsertRaw r v) ∪ {x} =
                (view l ∪ view r ∪ {x}) ∪ {v}
            rw [ir.2]
            ext z
            simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
            tauto

        · have hvEq : v = x := by
            omega
          have hins :
              bstInsertRaw (BinarySearchTree.Node x l r) v =
                BinarySearchTree.Node x l r := by
            simp [bstInsertRaw, hvx, hxv]
          rw [hins]
          constructor
          · change
              (∀ z ∈ view l, z < x) ∧
              is_bst l ∧
              (∀ z ∈ view r, z > x) ∧
              is_bst r
            exact ⟨hlBound, hlBst, hrBound, hrBst⟩
          · subst v
            ext z
            simp only [view, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
            tauto
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem insert_postcond_satisfied (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : insert_precond t v) :
    insert_postcond t v (insert t v h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  change
    is_bst (bstInsertRaw t v) ∧
    view (bstInsertRaw t v) = view t ∪ {v}
  exact bstInsertRaw_spec t v h_precond
  -- !benchmark @end proof
